qfoldit_quantum_lab.name: qfoldit-skills:qfoldit-quantum
capabilities: validated against exact diagonalization and the published H2/STO-3G benchmark (-1.1373 Hartree)
qfoldit_quantum_lab.source: bundled Claude Skill plugin, local statevector simulation — no network call
qfoldit_quantum_lab.notes: Bundled as a Claude Skill plugin rather than a standalone network MCP server; runs locally and deterministically. Distinct from protein_design_mcp's peptide-specific CVaR-VQE (QuPepFold) — this is general small-molecule/spin-Hamiltonian VQE. Treated as the canonical build for the 'quantum ground-state lab' domain on the strength of its own published-benchmark validation, same verified-status bar as protein_design_mcp.

qfoldit_qfold_lab.name: qfoldit-skills:qfoldit-qfold
capabilities: hybrid quantum-classical protein folding on the 2D HP (Dill, 1985) lattice model
QAOA-style circuit on Amazon Braket LocalSimulator
optional delegation to a full qFold MCP server when available
qfoldit_qfold_lab.source: bundled Claude Skill plugin, Amazon Braket LocalSimulator — no network call unless delegating
qfoldit_qfold_lab.notes: Bundled Claude Skill plugin, not a standalone network MCP server. NOT the same thing as simulate_quantum_walk_fold() in pipelines/quantum_runner.py -- that one is a classical Metropolis walk over continuous torsion angles; this is a QAOA circuit over the discrete HP lattice. Do not conflate the two when reporting results.

qfoldit_plant_growth_lab.name: qfoldit-skills:qfoldit-plant-growth-model + qfoldit-l-systems
capabilities: growth rate / morphology / deficiency-symptom estimation from NPK and light (PPFD, DLI, R:FR) inputs
renders resulting morphology as a procedural L-system plant (SVG)
qfoldit_plant_growth_lab.source: bundled Claude Skill plugins, local deterministic model — no network call
qfoldit_plant_growth_lab.notes: Two skills paired for one preset: plant-growth-model produces the numeric growth/morphology/deficiency result, l-systems renders it. The exact output field names below (growth_rate, compactness, deficiency_symptoms) are a best-effort mapping from the skill's own public description, not independently inspected in this authoring session -- same 'documented-uncertainty' convention as quantum_runner.py's qupepfold wrapper note. Adjust presets.py's MetricSpec keys once the real schema is confirmed.

qfoldit_oilgas_lab.name: qfoldit-skills:qfoldit-oilgas
capabilities: internal CO2 (sweet) corrosion rate via the published de Waard-Milliams correlation
protective-scale, flow/mass-transfer, salinity-pitting, and inhibitor-dosing adjustments
qfoldit_oilgas_lab.source: bundled Claude Skill plugin, local deterministic correlation — no network call
qfoldit_oilgas_lab.notes: Field names (corrosion_rate_mm_per_year, remaining_wall_life_years) are a best-effort mapping from the skill's public description, not independently inspected — same documented-uncertainty convention as above. Never fabricate a corrosion rate if the skill hasn't been run; presets.py refuses to build this level without a real result.

qfoldit_prospecting_lab.name: qfoldit-skills:qfoldit-prospecting
capabilities: indicator-taxon identification and response-ratio effect sizes
permutation-based validity check for whether a signal could be due to chance
qfoldit_prospecting_lab.source: bundled Claude Skill plugin, local statistical analysis — no network call
qfoldit_prospecting_lab.notes: Field names (anomaly_score, permutation_p_value) are a best-effort mapping from the skill's public description, not independently inspected -- documented-uncertainty convention as above. The permutation p-value is the one number this preset treats as load-bearing for its 'statistically significant' achievement -- never lower that bar to make an achievement unlock more easily.
